source_scope: Documented savings interest and APY-bonus rules available to this Skill. Missing values must not be inferred.

common_rules.card_bonus_stacking: Only the highest applicable active credit-card APY bonus applies. That selected bonus may stack with other verified bonus categories.
common_rules.linked_accounts: A qualifying checking-savings pairing requires the accounts to be under the same customer profile; linkage and effective dates must be verified for the disputed cycle.

qualifying_pairings_with_no_packaged_num: Blue Account + Platinum Account is documented with a numeric boost above; Light Green Account + Platinum Account also qualifies but its boost amount is not packaged.
Light Green Account + Diamond Elite Account qualifies, but its boost amount is not packaged.
Evergreen Account + Diamond Elite Account is documented with a numeric boost above.
Bluest Account + Silver Account is documented with a numeric boost above.
Blue Account + Silver Plus Account is documented with a numeric boost above.
